As Corporate Counsel, you will support corporate legal matters across our international group. Based in Dubai, you will advise on DIFC/UAE law, People and employment matters, corporate governance, commercial agreements and cross-border legal matters.

You will work closely with People, Finance, Operations and other business functions to turn legal requirements into practical advice, policies and business solutions.

"},{"text":"What you’ll do","content":"
  • Advise on DIFC and relevant UAE corporate and employment law, including requirements affecting our Dubai operations, DIFC entities, international group structure and global workforce.
  • Monitor relevant legal developments and coordinate specialist local counsel across jurisdictions where required.
  • Advise People/HR throughout the employment lifecycle, including hiring, employment and contractor models, compensation, performance matters, investigations and terminations.

  • Advise on contractual risk, liability, indemnities, confidentiality, intellectual property, data protection and termination.
  • Develop templates and contracting standards, and work with Procurement and business teams to improve contracting and approval processes.
  • Draft and review corporate policies, translate legal requirements into practical policies, processes and guidance, identify and assess material legal risks for appropriate escalation, and provide legal guidance and training to business teams.

    As Data & Analytics Lead, your mission is to turn complex business and product questions into reliable, actionable answers.

    You will combine AI, data analytics, data engineering, and deep DeFi expertise to build a more intelligent and scalable approach to decision-making. You will use AI not just to accelerate existing analytics, but to rethink how we explore data, test hypotheses, identify patterns, and make insights accessible across the organization.

    You will be highly hands-on, with expert-level Dune capabilities and a strong understanding of DEXes, DEX aggregators, on-chain data, liquidity, routing, and market dynamics.

    "},{"text":"What you’ll do","content":"

  • Shape and build a self-service data and AI platform that enables teams to ask better questions, find better answers, and make better decisions.

  • Create intuitive ways for teams to explore trusted data using AI, natural language, dashboards, and other analytical interfaces.

  • Build AI-enabled workflows and agents that accelerate analysis, uncover insights, and reduce repetitive analytical work, ensuring AI-generated answers are grounded in trusted data, transparent, and verifiable.

  • Turn complex and ambiguous business and product questions into structured analyses, clear insights, and actionable answers.

  • Develop metrics and analytical frameworks that connect user behavior, product performance, on-chain activity, market dynamics, and business outcomes.

  • Proactively identify trends, anomalies, opportunities, and risks, and establish standards for analytical quality, metrics, dashboards, and decision support.

  • Design and evolve data architecture, models, pipelines, and transformations, integrating on-chain and off-chain data into reliable, scalable, and reusable data products.

  • Ensure data is accurate, well-structured, documented, discoverable, and accessible to people and AI systems, with strong standards for quality, observability, maintainability, and performance.

  • Use Dune at an expert level to investigate DEX aggregators, DEXes, swaps, liquidity, routing, users, protocols, and markets, building reusable on-chain datasets and analytical models.

  • Combine blockchain, product, and business data to create a comprehensive view of users, ecosystem activity, and market dynamics, and continuously explore new data sources and analytical approaches.

    As Tech Lead, iOS, you’ll be the primary technical owner of the 1inch Wallet iOS application. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no direct people management responsibilities. You’ll own the app’s architecture and development, improve its CI/CD workflow and monitor it after release. You’ll work on wallet features including perpetual trading, prediction markets and DeFi staking, collaborating with the Product Owner, Android Lead and QA. You’ll also use AI-assisted tools in development and testing, applying sound engineering judgement to the code and tests they generate.
    "},{"text":"What you’ll do ","content":"
  • Own the iOS architecture and technical direction, balancing feature delivery, maintainability, performance and security.
  • Build and improve modular, testable application components, and guide implementation across complex wallet flows.
  • Implement wallet features and technical improvements across the iOS application.
  • Integrate the application with backend services, blockchain networks and related wallet services.
  • Work with Product, Android, Backend, Blockchain and QA on shared product behaviour, API integrations, test coverage and defect investigation
  • Use AI-assisted tools in development and testing, reviewing and validating their output against engineering, quality and security standards.
  • Protect sensitive information by keeping private keys, recovery phrases, credentials and user data out of AI prompts and inappropriate logs.
  • Own and improve the iOS build and CI/CD workflow; monitor releases, investigate production issues and coordinate fixes and improvements to stability.
